notes: GROUP 4 — 214 series across 12 files. SLUGS USED: id_consumer_prices (30), id_capital_markets (1), id_payment_systems (30), id_exchange_rate_operations (15), id_banking (30), id_government_accounts (3), id_workforce_unemployment (31), id_imports_exports (30), id_business_surveys (14), id_retail_sales (30). KEY NOTES: (1) DUPLICATES: series 225672502 and 389691887 are both 'Commercial & Rural Banks: Loans' from BI — kept both distinct IDs; NPL ratio appears twice (229675802 OJK, 65816201 CEIC) — retained. (2) REER/NEER multi-source: 4 different base years (2005=100, 2010=100, 2015=100, 2020=100, Index 2021) from BIS/World Bank/OECD/CEIC; subcategories disambiguate. (3) SEMIANNUAL series (IDN_Labor_LabourForce_Semiannual) all carry P1Y in slim.json despite 'Semiannually' in names — kept as sourced (BPS publishes Feb+Aug but CEIC likely snaps to annual). (4) PROVINCE-GRANULAR: labour force has AFF and Manufacturing breakdowns by province (Lampung, Bengkulu, South Sumatera, Jambi, Bangka Belitung, West Java, Banten); retail sales has city-level RSI (Jakarta, Bandung, Surabaya, Medan, Semarang, Denpasar, Makassar, Banjarmasin, Manado); RTGS has province-level value/volume for 11 provinces — all prefixed 'By province: X' in subcategory. (5) RTGS UNIT ANOMALY: two daily 'Weekly' series (477159997, 477160007) — one uses IDR tb (trillion) vs IDR bn for monthly series; kept as sourced. (6) GOVT SECURITIES: single daily series (foreign non-bank holders) assigned id_capital_markets per taxonomy guide. (7) BUSINESS TENDENCY: mixed frequencies — 13 quarterly (P3M), 1 monthly (P1M amplitude-adjusted). (8) MOTOR VEHICLE SALES in RetailSalesIndex file from GAIKINDO (automotive assoc.) — unit is 'Unit' not index; classified id_retail_sales as consistent with file intent.
